title: Biopsy Collection and Repository Database
official: Cardiac Biopsy Collection Repository and Database
summary: Use samples procured from patients to improve understanding of molecular, cellular, and tissue-level processes produced by a variety of cardiac diseases and therapeutic interventions.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* All patients undergoing evaluation of a cardiac condition or receiving a right heart catheterization with biopsy clinically indicated who are at least 18 years of age.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients without a cardiovascular or amyloidosis diagnosis, under 18 years of age.
